meta.name: escalation-design
meta.description: When and how AI should escalate to humans, refuse, or ask for clarification.

copy.tagline: 设计AI与人类协作的升级规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在构建AI系统时需要定义何时求助人类。
copy.tagline_en: Design escalation rules for AI-human collaboration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to define when AI should escalate to humans.

howto.what: 本技能指导AI在遇到不确定、高风险、用户情绪波动等情况时，主动将问题升级给人工客服或建议用户自行决策，而不是死循环或擅自处理。
howto.when: 当AI对回答信心低、任务涉及重大后果（如财务、医疗）、用户表现出情绪困扰、请求超出范围或违反策略，以及无法澄清歧义时触发。

say.text: 这个问题我无法确定，需要转给人工客服。
say.note: AI识别到信心不足时，会主动请求人工介入。

say.text: 涉及医疗建议，我建议您咨询专业医生。
say.note: 高风险场景下，AI拒绝并指引正确渠道。

say.text: 您看起来心情不好，需要我帮您联系人工支持吗？
say.note: 检测到用户情绪 distress 时，提供升级选项。

howto.what_en: This skill makes the AI escalate to human support, refuse, or ask for clarification when it hits boundaries like low confidence, high stakes, user distress, unresolvable ambiguity, or policy violations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when confidence is low, stakes are high (financial, medical, legal, safety), user shows emotional distress, request is out-of-scope or against policy, or ambiguity cannot be resolved.

say_en.text: I'm not sure about this; let me transfer you to a human.
say_en.note: AI escalates due to low confidence.

say_en.text: For medical advice, please consult a professional.
You seem upset; would you like me to connect you with support?
say_en.note: AI detects distress and offers human escalation.
